integrity: A self-contained symbolic proof is supplied. Exact finite checks corroborate only selected calculations and do not certify infinite claims or large primality.
scientific_limitations: Only reduced positive nonintegers with squarefree numerators are classified. The primality condition on q^q-30 is conditional; no existence or infinitude assertion and no large-prime certificate. The denominator lemma and sufficient prime construction are known prior results; novelty, if any, resides in the necessity of the complete four-prime converse. Unindexed prior coverage remains possible.
title: Four-prime squarefree numerators for rational arithmetic antiderivatives of one
